passages.text: “At this my heart also pounds and leaps from its place.
passages.sermon: My heart feels fear because of this.\r\nMy heart pounds strongly.\r\nMy heart leaps out of its place.
passages.original: אַף־ לְ֭זֹאת יֶחֱרַ֣ד לִבִּ֑י וְ֝יִתַּ֗ר מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Listen closely to the thunder of His voice and the rumbling that comes from His mouth.
passages.sermon:
God speaks with a powerful voice.
His voice sounds like thunder.
A deep rumbling comes from His mouth.
Listen carefully to His voice.
Pay attention to the sound that comes from Him.
passages.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּרֹ֣גֶז קֹל֑וֹ וְ֝הֶ֗גֶה מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא׃

passages.text: He unleashes His lightning beneath the whole sky and sends it to the ends of the earth.
passages.sermon:
God acts with great power.
God sends lightning.
God sends lightning under the whole sky.
God sends light to the ends of the earth.
God’s power reaches everywhere.
No place is outside God’s reach.
passages.original: תַּֽחַת־ כָּל־ הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם יִשְׁרֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אוֹר֗וֹ עַל־ כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Then there comes a roaring sound; He thunders with His majestic voice. He does not restrain the lightning when His voice resounds.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful and majestic.
A roaring sound comes after Him.
God thunders with His majestic voice.
He does not hold back the lightning when His voice is heard.
passages.original: אַחֲרָ֤יו׀ יִשְׁאַג־ ק֗וֹל יַ֭רְעֵם בְּק֣וֹל גְּאוֹנ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יְ֝עַקְּבֵ֗ם כִּֽי־ יִשָּׁמַ֥ע קוֹלֽוֹ׃

passages.text: God thunders wondrously with His voice; He does great things we cannot comprehend.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
God thunders with His voice.
His voice is wondrous.
God does great things.
We cannot understand these great things.
passages.original: יַרְעֵ֤ם אֵ֣ל בְּ֭קוֹלוֹ נִפְלָא֑וֹת עֹשֶׂ֥ה גְ֝דֹל֗וֹת וְלֹ֣א נֵדָֽע׃

passages.text: For He says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ and to the gentle rain, ‘Pour out a mighty downpour.’
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the snow.
God commands the snow to fall on the earth.
God speaks to the rain.
God commands the gentle rain to pour down.
God commands the rain to release a mighty downpour.
God controls the snow and the rain.
God directs the weather by His word.
passages.original: כִּ֤י לַשֶּׁ֨לַג׀ יֹאמַ֗ר הֱוֵ֫א אָ֥רֶץ וְגֶ֥שֶׁם מָטָ֑ר וְ֝גֶ֗שֶׁם מִטְר֥וֹת עֻזּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He seals up the hand of every man, so that all men may know His work.
passages.sermon:
God acts with power and wisdom.
God seals the hand of every person.
He does this so that all people may know His work.
God wants everyone to recognize what He has done.
passages.original: בְּיַד־ כָּל־ אָדָ֥ם יַחְתּ֑וֹם לָ֝דַ֗עַת כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃

passages.text: The wild animals enter their lairs; they settle down in their dens.
passages.sermon:
Wild animals live on the earth.
Wild animals have dens.
Wild animals go into their dens.
Wild animals settle down inside their dens.
passages.original: וַתָּבֹ֣א חַיָּ֣ה בְמוֹ־ אָ֑רֶב וּבִמְע֖וֹנֹתֶ֣יהָ תִשְׁכֹּֽן׃

passages.text: The tempest comes from its chamber, and the cold from the driving north winds.
passages.sermon:
God controls the weather.
A storm comes out from its chamber.
Cold air comes from the strong north winds.
God sends both the tempest and the cold.
passages.original: מִן־ הַ֭חֶדֶר תָּב֣וֹא סוּפָ֑ה וּֽמִמְּזָרִ֥ים קָרָֽה׃

passages.text: By the breath of God the ice is formed and the watery expanses are frozen.
passages.sermon:
God breathes.
His breath creates ice.
His breath freezes wide waters.
The water becomes solid because of God.
passages.original: מִנִּשְׁמַת־ אֵ֥ל יִתֶּן־ קָ֑רַח וְרֹ֖חַב מַ֣יִם בְּמוּצָֽק׃

passages.text: He loads the clouds with moisture; He scatters His lightning through them.
passages.sermon:
God acts with power and wisdom.
God fills the clouds with moisture.
God sends lightning through the clouds.
God spreads the lightning across the sky.
passages.original: אַף־ בְּ֭רִי יַטְרִ֣יחַ עָ֑ב יָ֝פִ֗יץ עֲנַ֣ן אוֹרֽוֹ׃

passages.text: They swirl about, whirling at His direction, accomplishing all that He commands over the face of all the earth.
passages.sermon:
God controls the clouds and the weather.
He causes them to move in circles.
He makes them turn and change direction.
He uses His wisdom to guide them.
They do everything He commands.
They obey Him everywhere on the earth.
passages.original: וְה֤וּא מְסִבּ֨וֹת׀ מִתְהַפֵּ֣ךְ בְּתַחְבּוּלָתוֹ לְפָעֳלָ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצַוֵּ֓ם׀ עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י תֵבֵ֣ל אָֽרְצָה׃

passages.text: Whether for punishment or for His land, He accomplishes this in His loving devotion.
passages.sermon:
God acts with purpose.
He may act to punish.
He may act for His land.
He may act to show loving devotion.
God always accomplishes what He intends.
passages.original: אִם־ לְשֵׁ֥בֶט אִם־ לְאַרְצ֑וֹ אִם־ לְ֝חֶ֗סֶד יַמְצִאֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Listen to this, O Job; stand still and consider the wonders of God.
passages.sermon:
Job, listen to this.
Stop and pay attention.
Think about the wonders of God.
God does amazing things.
God’s works are wonderful.
passages.original: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה זֹּ֣את אִיּ֑וֹב עֲ֝מֹ֗ד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵ֤ן׀ נִפְלְא֬וֹת אֵֽל׃

passages.text: Do you know how God dispatches the clouds or makes the lightning flash?
passages.sermon:
God controls the clouds.
God sends the clouds where He wants.
God makes the lightning shine from the clouds.
Do you know how God does this?
God alone has this power.
passages.original: הֲ֭תֵדַע בְּשׂוּם־ אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝הוֹפִ֗יעַ א֣וֹר עֲנָנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Do you understand how the clouds float, those wonders of Him who is perfect in knowledge?
passages.sermon:
God is perfect in knowledge.
He does wonderful things.
Clouds float in the sky.
Do you understand how the clouds float?
Do you understand these wonders of God?
passages.original: הֲ֭תֵדַע עַל־ מִפְלְשֵׂי־ עָ֑ב מִ֝פְלְא֗וֹת תְּמִ֣ים דֵּעִֽים׃

passages.text: You whose clothes get hot when the land lies hushed under the south wind, can you, like Him, spread out the skies to reflect the heat like a mirror of bronze?
passages.sermon:
God controls the weather.
God sends the south wind.
The south wind makes the land quiet.
The south wind makes your clothes hot.
God spreads out the skies.
The skies become strong.
The skies shine like a mirror made of bronze.
You cannot spread out the skies like God.
You cannot make the skies reflect heat like God.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁר־ בְּגָדֶ֥יךָ חַמִּ֑ים בְּהַשְׁקִ֥ט אֶ֝֗רֶץ מִדָּרֽוֹם׃ תַּרְקִ֣יעַ עִ֭מּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִ֑ים חֲ֝זָקִ֗ים כִּרְאִ֥י מוּצָֽק׃

passages.text: Teach us what we should say to Him; we cannot draw up our case when our faces are in darkness.
passages.sermon:
We do not know what to say to God.
We need someone to teach us what to say.
We cannot present our case to God.
We are in darkness.
We cannot see clearly.
We do not have understanding.
passages.original: ה֭וֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה־ נֹּ֣אמַר ל֑וֹ לֹ֥א־ נַ֝עֲרֹ֗ךְ מִפְּנֵי־ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

passages.text: Should He be told that I want to speak? Would a man ask to be swallowed up ?
passages.sermon:
God is almighty.
God is beyond our understanding.
Should anyone tell God that I want to speak?
Should a person ask to be destroyed?
passages.original: הַֽיְסֻפַּר־ ל֭וֹ כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אִֽם־ אָ֥מַר אִ֝֗ישׁ כִּ֣י יְבֻלָּֽע׃

passages.text: Now no one can gaze at the sun when it is bright in the skies after the wind has swept them clean.
passages.sermon:
No one can look at the sun now.
The sun shines brightly in the sky.
The wind has passed through the sky.
The wind has made the sky clear.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֤ה׀ לֹ֘א רָ֤אוּ א֗וֹר בָּהִ֣יר ה֭וּא בַּשְּׁחָקִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ עָ֝בְרָ֗ה וַֽתְּטַהֲרֵֽם׃

passages.text: Out of the north He comes in golden splendor; awesome majesty surrounds Him.
passages.sermon:
God is awesome in majesty.
He comes from the north.
He shines with golden splendor.
His presence is glorious.
passages.original: מִ֭צָּפוֹן זָהָ֣ב יֶֽאֱתֶ֑ה עַל־ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נ֣וֹרָא הֽוֹד׃

passages.text: The Almighty is beyond our reach; He is exalted in power! In His justice and great righteousness He does not oppress.
passages.sermon:
The Almighty is God.
God is beyond our reach.
God is exalted in power.
God acts with justice.
God has great righteousness.
God does not oppress anyone.
passages.original: שַׁדַּ֣י לֹֽא־ מְ֭צָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא־ כֹ֑חַ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט וְרֹב־ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Therefore, men fear Him, for He is not partial to the wise in heart.”
passages.sermon:
God is awesome in majesty.
He is exalted in power.
He is just and righteous.
He does not oppress anyone.
Therefore, people fear God.
God does not show special favor to those who are wise in heart.
passages.original: לָ֭כֵן יְרֵא֣וּהוּ אֲנָשִׁ֑ים לֹֽא־ יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה כָּל־ חַכְמֵי־ לֵֽב׃פ
